target_scope: authenticated native Termux shell on the recorded Android 16/aarch64 target
method_note: An initial ad hoc tab-delimited parser used the wrong escaped delimiter and falsely classified entries as missing. The raw dpkg-query format was checked on known installed packages, then the corrected pipe-delimited query was run across all 77 entries; only the corrected 77/77 result is evidence.
historical_limits: This verifies current installed package names and versions against the recovered APT history record only.
It does not recreate the complete pre-consent simulation shown during the original 77-package install.
The later live preview record is a separate four-package xfce4-power-manager probe and is not represented as the original XFCE preview.
No original repository index snapshot or archive hashes were present in APT history; this audit does not invent them.
